finding.packet_premise: docs/MULTI_MENU_SCREENS.md proposed 00683610 as a fade/slide animation record shared by the front-end screens.
finding.actual: 00683610 is the constructor of a vertical scroll controller: a content widget that slides along Y, a scroll bar thumb, two optional arrow widgets, a pointer drag path and an axis auto-scroll path.
finding.evidence: No phase, duration, easing curve or frame delta occurs in any of the thirteen methods at 00683300..00683A8F. 00683440 computes (offset/range)*travel and 00683820 reads input axes and a cursor position.

ghidra_decompiler_errors.truth: ECX is the content widget at [ESI] for 00AA8240 (loaded at 006837BE) and ESI itself for 00683440 (00683809).

x87_notes.note: (offset/range)*travel: the quotient is never narrowed to float between the FDIV and the FMUL, so divide and multiply share one rounding.
(track + min_height) - range is one x87 expression with a single store to a float slot at 00683501.
the unclamped drag Y, (thumb_base.y + anchor) + (cursor_y - anchor_cursor_y), is one expression with a single store at 0068392D.
the drag fraction IS stored to a float slot and reloaded before the multiply, so it rounds twice.
the X and Z zeros in every position composition are FLDZ: the compiler folded a zero vector, so the source reads base +/- offset rather than a direct store.
UCOMISS/LAHF/TEST AH,44h inequality pattern: a NaN range counts as not equal to zero. The COMISS/JC at 006834C3 likewise sends a NaN range down the scrollable path.
the thumb-height max is a pointer select, so a NaN candidate keeps min_height.

uncertainties: The GUI Y convention is not established, so 00683680 and 00683700 are named toward the start and toward the end of the list rather than up and down.
00683820 applies +24h once per call with no frame delta; either the input axis at +36B4h is already time-scaled or the scroll is frame-rate dependent.
Input manager instance +4h fields +36B4h and +3714h are two axes with the second as a fallback; which physical control each is was not traced.

004BA6D0 is ledger-tagged stl_instantiation but is called here as __thiscall(1, 0) on the singleton at 00F8BBF4, returning an object whose virtual +24h reads an analog axis. The tag looks wrong for this call site.
+59h has no writer and +4Ch no reader inside 00683300..00683A8F.
Widget virtuals +4Ch and +58h are named alpha setter and size setter from their arguments only; the widget class was not identified.
